svg.title: Crash trials that ran the side effect twice
svg.desc: A grid of dots, one dot per trial, five per cell, for six rows of saver and durability mode and five kill points, in two panels for the graph and the agent. Rose dots ran the side effect twice: 80 of 150 graph trials and 82 of 150 agent trials. Every trial killed inside the effect ran it twice, and sync with a kill after the step ran it once on both savers.
svg.text: not killed, exit mode never reached it
Totals: graph 80 of 150, agent 82 of 150, graph with a key 0 of 150. The Mac.
